biggest_gaps: Repetition and padding: the daily-routine section restates the same three points (cold water, mild unscented soap, rinse residue) three times in a row; tighten to one clear instruction set and use the space for something new.

Vagueness where the benchmark is concrete: 'What should you avoid?' and the no-pot sterilising answer both defer to 'the instructions' instead of naming the cleaners the owner's care guide warns against (bleach, vinegar, tea tree oil, hydrogen peroxide, antibacterial soap, harsh alcohol) — if that data wasn't supplied, say so plainly rather than gesturing at it.

Missing the trade-off framing that makes the benchmark useful: no acknowledgement that cleaning requires access to clean water/private facilities, that heavier flow may mean emptying before eight hours, or that a cup isn't for everyone — add a short 'what this routine asks of you' note.
what_new_does_well: Clear two-routine structure (daily wash vs between-cycle sterilise) that maps directly to the search intent and is easy to scan.
Good safety and caution language: stop if pain, general-information disclaimer, and repeated 'follow the included instructions' framing.
Accurate use of supplied product facts (capacities, eight-hour wear, swimming/exercise, 5–10 year lifespan, cotton machine-washable pouch) without inventing claims.
